## About
Certified Alignments is a small automotive shop in Temple Hills, set up to take care of your car's alignment, front-end suspension and other ride-related needs. We work on most cars and light trucks, and we use Hunter alignment equipment.
A lot of folks find us by word of mouth. One reviewer came in because their mechanic sent them, and another came on a referral from a satisfied customer. We're rated 4.7 from 270 Google reviews, and we'd be glad to have you stop by.

## Services
- 4-wheel alignments: Alignments done on Hunter equipment. Some adjustments and parts, plus custom, lifted, lowered or modified vehicles, cost extra.
- Front-end work: Front-end repairs like ball joints, tie-rods and C.V. drive axles.
- Brakes, shocks and suspension: Brake, shock, strut and suspension work. Call with your questions first.
- Parts inspection: Have your front-end parts looked over. (From $30)
- Tire mounting: Tire mounting off the vehicle. (From $25)

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: For the fastest service, please call ahead for an appointment.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 10 to 5. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can the alignment price go up?
A: Some camber and caster adjustments, heat, bushings or shims cost extra, and so do custom wheels and lifted, lowered or modified vehicles.
